name: 追踪攻击
description: 传送至4格内、身旁存在空的可通行格的敌人身旁，造成100%攻击力物理伤害；每3层动能伤害+1。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,b=context.battle,t=selectTarget({type:'piece',range:4,filter:'enemy'});if(!t||t.needsTargetSelection)return t;var cells=[[0,-1],[1,0],[0,1],[-1,0]];var dest=null;for(var i=0;i<cells.length;i++){var x=t.x+cells[i][0],y=t.y+cells[i][1],tile=b.map.tiles.find(function(q){return q.x===x&&q.y===y;});if(tile&&tile.props.walkable&&!b.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===x&&p.y===y;})){dest={x:x,y:y};break;}}if(!dest)return {success:false,message:'目标身旁没有空的可通行格'};c.x=dest.x;c.y=dest.y;var r=dealDamage(c,t,c.attack+Math.floor((c.momentum||0)/3),'physical',b,context.skill.id);return {success:true,message:'追踪攻击造成'+r.damage+'点伤害'};}
